findings.finding: The current repository is not at an external frontier: RESEARCH-001 and extensive formal/synthetic/interface work remain executable.
The prior task graph unnecessarily made MATH-001 and VERTICAL-001 depend on external sealed custody; those dependencies are removed while EVAL-001 remains gated.
The prior graph omitted explicit outcomes, baselines, calibration, economics, architecture, security, observability, replay, adversarial, external-readiness, and convergence work.
The current route evaluator proves a narrow exact-ten/protection boundary only and cannot support broad connected-system readiness.
A correct current frontier result is FAIL, not BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, because all 23 domain gates still have autonomous failures or missing prerequisites.
After artifact freshness and invariant-trace enforcement, the exact current result is 0 PASS, 23 FAIL, and 0 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL.

Repository-local or builder-owned out-of-repository verifier files cannot establish external authority; closing external evidence requires a non-builder-owned, non-builder-writable authority configuration that pins verifier and trust-root digests.
A completed task must have a completed canonical task result and no open direct gate; cached status labels cannot bypass recomputation.

decisions: Require 23 stable frontier gates: the 22 requested domains plus an explicit two-round convergence-sweeps gate.
Apply global precedence FAIL, then BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, then PASS.
Allow BLOCKED_EXTERNAL only after all autonomous checks pass, the blocker uses an external capability class with exact owner/unlock/evidence, no executable task remains, and the repository is clean.
Execute exact-PASS verification commands as a single explicit repository Python script without a shell in an isolated copy and fail on repository mutation.
Require known-bad results to bind exact case ID, fixture SHA-256, and registered diagnostic; altered fixture semantics and hash-aware echo-only wrappers fail.
Require external authority configuration, verifier, and trust root to be outside the repository, owned by a different OS principal, builder-nonwritable, and digest-pinned.
Keep RESEARCH-001 active and remove sealed-custody dependency from autonomous MATH-001 and VERTICAL-001.
risks: The frontier evaluator is public and builder-writable; its own proof ceiling is level 4 and it cannot prove sealed or hidden independence.
Many future gate commands and artifacts intentionally do not exist yet, so the current FAIL result is expected and load-bearing.
A large contract can become stale unless domain tasks update evidence, proof levels, uncertainties, commands, and claim ceilings together.
External attestations require a separately controlled trust anchor and digest binding; repository-local self-signing must never close those gates.
rollback: The rollback baseline is commit 04e2581928eb701b8a4b4ab558cebfe19b9b4b1a. Revert the coherent FRONTIER-001 checkpoint to restore the accepted RESEARCH-001 state; do not weaken mission, proof, authority, evaluator-independence, or claim-ceiling rules.
